qualification: Immutable private worker bitmap snapshots:576 bytes per4096 original IDs, schema/generation/block/count/reserved/CRC32C/zero-tail and exact native size checks. Original row namespace and unique snapshot revisions. Null snapshot means exact all-clear; failed/corrupt state never becomes an empty selection. Full target quota reservation before factory; one bitmap block retained per advance, no directory-sized RAM bitset.

Single visible row, inclusive visible-rank range with reversed endpoints, mark/unmark-visible, invert-visible and explicit clear-all commands. Hidden marks survive bulk commands and filter/sort changes. Copy-on-write output, bounded worker advances, short transfer progress validation, cancellation/exception cleanup and native domain/code preservation. Explicit clear-all recovers corrupt marks without reading them, without repairing a failed dataset.

Prepared changes bind pending stamp, exact data revision and prior mark revision; publication is IO-free and rejects superseded replies. Pending marks block focus/further changes/candidates. Failed or cancelled changes preserve the prior snapshot/counts. Successful new navigation clears selection; failed navigation preserves it. Invalid parameter/target/quota rejection leaves valid state intact.

View preparation recounts immutable marks against the new disk lookup with bounded original-row work, then revalidates the native directory. Completed data retains only mark revision/count, avoiding ownership of obsolete mark files; publication rejects missing/wrong revision. Hidden marks yield HiddenMarksNeedReview with zero candidates. Corrupt sources yield SelectionInvalidated with no claimed counts; no marks uses visible cursor only.

Owner-free bounded display pages copy mark flags, summary, pending state and fully charged diagnostics. Mark IO failure discards the whole page and revokes the current stamp; a newer request during IO wins. Saved pages remain readable after native/cache retirement, with stamps revoked.

14 new deterministic cases cover single/range/bulk/invert/clear, hidden counts and restore, invalid targets/limits/quota, cancellation at each worker boundary, failures/abandonment/stale callbacks, corruption/native read denial, CRC-valid tail padding, short/zero IO, simultaneous disk-full and cancellation, factory error/throw and quota release, absent recount certificate, and4096/4097 boundary in4101 records with old immutable snapshots. Popcount inconsistencies revoke the corrupt snapshot during both changes and view recounts.

review.cleanup: Each completed diagnostic output hashed before removal after exact owned-process and empty-fixture checks. Superseded diagnostic trees removed; current verified normal builds and SDK retained for active work. Documentation scratch removed after strict build.
review.scope: No native mutation authority, partial bitmap publication, permissive safety bypass or unbounded production RAM fallback introduced. Native errors win over simultaneous cancellation except the explicit interrupted-read result. Clear-all remains explicit and cannot repair a damaged dataset.
review.whitespace: git diff --check; staged check before commit.

limitations: WP-01 remains in progress; WP-02 through WP-08 remain unstarted. Indexed native source acquisition/selection inventories and remaining destination preservation/collision capabilities and qualification are still required.

Core/native integration only: no Files UI, rendered-window claim, full-application latency/RSS result or100000-real-entry directory qualification. The4101 case uses deterministic in-memory test adapters;100000 records are synthetic native cache data; real-directory coverage is259 entries.

Mark counts and row IDs are planning/display state, never native authority. Operation acquisition must perform fresh native identity/continuity/capability checks and enforce precise scoped user consent for metadata/channel loss. No copy/move/delete API is introduced.

Single-row changes copy the bitmap in bounded worker steps; bulk/range/recount scan original IDs. These are cooperative jobs and native IO can block. Shared quotas bound disk/file ownership; they do not establish physical allocation, cumulative IO or full-app memory/latency limits.

CRC is corruption detection inside the private-cache trust boundary, not authentication or restart persistence. Snapshot consistency, network/removable/provider/crash/full-disk/different-account qualification remains outstanding.

Controllers must pass the current mark snapshot into view preparation, drop superseded workers, bound retained pages/queues, and route model access through a serialized worker. The result revision gates reject missing snapshots; no controller/UI has yet been added.
